text:
TCP::proxybufferlow
Description
This iRule command gets the proxy buffer low threshold, which is the
threshold at which the proxy buffer starts sending new data, in bytes.
Syntax
TCP
::
proxybufferlow
Examples
when
SERVER_CONNECTED
{
log
local0.debug
"[TCP::proxybufferlow]"
}
